queries: WITH invoiced_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, c.gender FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL), gender_counts AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS invoiced_order_count FROM invoiced_orders GROUP BY gender), totals AS (SELECT SUM(invoiced_order_count) AS overall_count, COUNT(*) AS gender_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT g.gender, g.invoiced_order_count, 1.0 * g.invoiced_order_count / t.overall_count AS share, 1.0 * g.invoiced_order_count / t.overall_count - 1.0 / t.gender_count AS above_average_share FROM gender_counts AS g CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE 1.0 * g.invoiced_order_count / t.overall_count > 1.0 / t.gender_count

WITH invoiced_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, c.gender FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id), gender_counts AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS invoiced_order_count FROM invoiced_orders GROUP BY gender), shares AS (SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, invoiced_order_count * 1.0 / SUM(invoiced_order_count) OVER () AS share FROM gender_counts), compared AS (SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: An order with multiple invoices counts once; customers with NULL gender are excluded from the gender shares.

alternatives.interpretation: Count each linked invoice as an invoiced order, so an order with multiple invoices contributes multiple times.
